To: Wilson Jones <wjones@atterleyappliances.com>
From: Javi Preston <javipreston@yukoandjavisplace.com>
Date: April 22
Subject: Appliance delivery

Dear Mr. Jones:

I am sending this e-mail to (135)_____ Atterley Appliances for your delivery service. It was excellent and exceeded my (136)_____ in every way. My restaurant, Yuko and Javi's Place, is housed in a very old building with no elevator. The chest freezer I ordered from Atterley Appliances had to be delivered to the building's top floor. (137)_____ It took careful maneuvering to avoid damaging the stairway walls on the way up. Thanks to the team's patience and attention to detail, the new freezer was installed with no damage to the (138)_____ structure. Many thanks to Atterley Appliances for your quality service.

Yours truly,
Javi Preston

Marfisa Fashions Acquires Corvak Group

LOS ANGELES (May 11)—Marfisa Fashions, a leading designer of men's apparel, announced today that it has acquired the Tokyo-based Corvak Group. (143)_____ The news confirms speculation that Marfisa's executives (144)_____ a company with robust distribution channels in Asia.

"Corvak Group's reach in Asian markets will be a tremendous asset for us," said Jun-Young Min, Marfisa's CEO. "Our clients have been telling us for years that we need a stronger presence in Asia. (145)_____ we are better able to meet their needs." While the press release did not specify the amount of the (146)_____, most analysts agree it was likely in the range of $100 to $150 million.
